about: The art bot's queue: the live art tracker's prompts (read 2026-11-05), in tracker order (act, then row). Differences from the tracker (user requests): "clean 1px dark outline" removed from the world and effect prompts; prompts with a "base" are edits of that approved picture (approved/<KEY>.png on the art-drafts branch) instead of "the same ..." and wait until it exists; "animations" (from the tracker's Detail column) and 8 directions are made from the approved picture after every still is done. Skipped: EN-01 (acquired), BO-05 (found), IC-01/IC-02/WO-10 (no prompt). A key is <ID>-<n>, follow-ups <ID>-<n>+8dir and <ID>-<n>+<action>; keys in the drafts branch's progress.json are not made again.
